scripts.build:android:local: mkdir -p builds && EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACTS_DIR="$PWD/builds" npx eas-cli@latest build -p android --profile production --local
scripts.build:ios:local: mkdir -p builds && EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACTS_DIR="$PWD/builds" npx eas-cli@latest build -p ios --profile production --local
